confidence_notes: Model estimates, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Food and drink anchors are better grounded than accommodation, where July demand makes the hostel and hotel anchors least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX reading is the RBA 13 October 2026 observation, taken from search-result summaries of the RBA overview page rather than a direct read of the RBA table; a 14 October figure could not be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Porto was benchmarked against Lisbon and mid-sized Iberian tourist cities such as Seville and Valencia, with food and drink set somewhat below Lisbon levels and accommodation adjusted for July peak demand. Local euro-denominated price levels were expressed in USD.
